page.layout: One page of text, one column, with Greek and Latin running text. Marginal notes in the left margin: "Deliberatio." beside the paragraph on Octavius, and "Cunctatio." beside the paragraph on Augustus. Page number 248 at the head, running head "CYRIACI LENTULI".

main_text.p: [illegible, ~60 letters] Hæc itaque Romani fub regibus, inque populari Reip. administratione, & violenta paucorum dominatione, & operati & paffi funt. ex eo autem tempore iterum ab uno imperari abfque controverfia coeperunt. quanquam armorum depo-nendorum, refque omnes fenatus populique poteftati tradendi confilium Cæfar agitavit. Hæc Dio. Exeo igitur tempore Monarchiæ imperialis jus, & delatam à populo Romano poteftatem, ductum Dionis Caffii fecuti, contemplemur.

Deliberatio. Deponendi imperii deliberationem Octavius infti-tuit, adhibitis in confilium Agrippa & Mæcenate, ar-canorum omnium intimis. [illegible, ~30 letters] Non aliud igitur imperii jus, quam violentum, ar-mis oppressæ patriæ extortum, Auguftus habuit. nec potuit Agrippæ aut Mæcenatis affenfus, hominum in rep. Romana novorum, aut nullo honore functorum, Remp. quafi in finu fuo locatam, transferre. Quid? quod unum tantum Mæcenatis Cæfar fuffragium tu-lit. nam Agrippa confiliis monarchicis aperte refi-stebat.

Vis igitur deliberandi in eo pofita fuerit: egregiam nunc effe occafionem remp. armis defatigatam, inva-dendi: fublatis æmulis, ægro reip. inermis corpore, quid igitur in ea rerum opportunitate autores effent? Speciofa Agrippa & magnis nominibus honefta: uti-lia Mæcenas & blandientia Augufto fuggeffit. procul dubio in fententiam tracturus, quem cupido regnandi ad arma civilia impulerat. Hæc Monarchiæ Romanæ aufpicia, examuffim cum Cornelii dictis confentientia.
Cunctatio. Aliud argumentum cunctatio Augufti, & res imperii fle&endi trepidatio, fuppeditat. [illegible, ~25 letters]

page.notes: The Greek passages are printed in Greek type and are too faint to read letter by letter, so they are marked as illegible; their approximate length is given. The page number and running head are as printed. The bare "6." is a section number and is kept as a paragraph, not a heading. No catchword or signature is printed.
